visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Text too small to read
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The body text is meant to be 18px but it renders at the default size. The size is written as a bare number, which CSS ignores.

solution.explanation: A length in CSS needs a unit, such as px, rem or %. Only the number 0 may be written without one. A rule with an invalid value is ignored, so the browser uses the default size.
